definitions.gloss: policy; measure; initiative; plan of action
definitions.explanation: A concrete plan or action taken by a government, organization, or company to address a problem or achieve a goal. More specific and action-oriented than 政策 (broad policy direction).

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{施策|しさく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}す。
{環境|かんきょう}{対策|たいさく}の{施策|しさく}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{政府|せいふ}は{少子化|しょうしか}に{対|たい}するさまざまな{施策|しさく}を{検討|けんとう}している。
examples.english: The government is considering various measures to address the declining birthrate.

notes: Often confused with {政策|せいさく} (policy). {施策|しさく} refers to specific measures or actions taken to implement a broader policy, while {政策|せいさく} refers to the overall policy direction. Also distinct from the homophone {思索|しさく} (contemplation). Common collocations: {施策|しさく}を{講|こう}じる (to take measures), {施策|しさく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}す (to put forward an initiative), {施策|しさく}を{推進|すいしん}する (to promote measures).
